items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: The Superior Band, in that band, I, when I first seen that band, they had, uh, uh, uh, Mac Murray on drums.

ctx.x: What about two beat and four beat and so on? Did they keep that bass drum boom, boom, boom going all the time?

No, you see, drummers like Mac Murray and Jean Vina, fellas, they never played no full beat. They played all those drummers played two beats. They never played no full beat. The first time I heard four beats played was King Oliver and O'Reilly was playing at the Columny Hall and Rain Happy was with the band. And they was playing the blues. And that's the first time I seen that full full beat. Full full. That's the first time I seen it playing the blues. And Happy was the first man that I see that used that.…
And how did you happen to switch back to two beat? Who was that? Yourself. Myself?
